articles.title: NCTE forms two committees to revise teacher recruitment rules, CTET and STET eligibility for ITEP graduates
articles.summary: The National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) has formed two expert committees to review teacher recruitment qualifications and CTET and STET eligibility rules to include four-year ITEP graduates. The proposed changes come ahead of the first batch graduating in 2027 and aim to align existing regulations with the integrated teacher education degree..
